component.name: StageRig
component.summary: Live-performance plugin host for keyboards and audio

description.p: StageRig hosts instruments and effects for playing live, for keyboards and for audio. Keyboards play instruments; a microphone, a guitar or a hardware synth plugged into the audio interface runs through effects. Build a program for each sound in your set, and change sounds from the keyboard, a footswitch, or a tablet on a music stand with no app to install.

ul.li: MIDI inputs and audio inputs side by side, each with 128 programs selected by MIDI Program Change
VST3, CLAP, LV2 and LADSPA instruments and effects, with splits, layers, velocity curves and insert effects
Songs and set lists stepped with a footswitch, with lead sheets and charts shown on the tablet
Any loaded plugin's own interface mirrored to a tablet or phone, fully operable
Audio inputs with effect chains and level meters; outputs on the interface's channels with master effects
Every plugin in its own process, so a crash takes only that plugin down
